Terms of sale

How we sell, take payment, deliver and refund.

Seller

Premium Drones Georgia LLC. Storage and service: 12 Panaskerteli-Tsitsishvili St, Tbilisi, by appointment. Warehouse and field operations: Lagodekhi. Phone and WhatsApp: +995 550 00 43 33. Email: info@premium-drones.ge.

Prices and payment

You send your order from the cart by WhatsApp or e-mail. We confirm price, availability and delivery, then send you an invoice, and you pay by bank transfer. Online card payment is not currently enabled on the website.

Online payment: orders under ₾20,000 are paid in full by card (Visa, Mastercard), Apple Pay or Google Pay on Bank of Georgia’s secure page. For orders of ₾20,000 or more you pay a 10% deposit online and the rest by bank transfer against our invoice. We never see or store your card details.

Order confirmation

After you send an order we confirm price, stock and delivery by phone or WhatsApp. An order is confirmed only after our confirmation, and counts as paid when the money reaches our account.

Delivery

Delivery within Georgia: ₾30 for orders under ₾100, free for orders of ₾100 or more. After your order is confirmed, delivery in Tbilisi is the same or the next day, and 1–3 days in the regions. Pickup from our Tbilisi storage is free, by appointment.

Returns and refunds

You can return an item within 14 days of receiving it if it is unused, complete and in its original packaging. Contact us first. You can bring it to our Tbilisi storage (by appointment) or send it by courier. Return shipping is paid by the customer; if the item is faulty or you received the wrong item, we cover it. We refund the amount paid to the same account or card within 14 days of receiving the item back. If we cannot deliver your order, we refund what you paid in full.

Warranty

XAG products carry the official XAG warranty: 1 year, and 1 year or 1500 cycles on batteries. We do diagnostics and repair in Georgia.

Personal data and privacy

We collect only what you send us: your name, phone, e-mail and delivery address (orders, consultation requests, your account), and the messages you write in the chat. We use this data only to answer your request and to process and deliver your order.

If you sign in with Google, we receive only your name and e-mail address from Google. Passwords are stored only in encrypted (hashed) form. Chat replies are generated by AI (OpenAI), so chat messages are sent to it to prepare the answer.

We use Google Analytics and Cloudflare Web Analytics to see how the site is used. The site is hosted on Cloudflare and e-mails are sent through Resend. We do not sell your data or share it with others for advertising.

To see, correct or delete your data, write to info@premium-drones.ge.
